answer: What survives to the meadow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime. The nebula is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the canyon. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
